item.description:
feat(nature-figure): allow any OpenAI-compatible images endpoint via --api-url

The schematic script already takes --api-key-env, but the endpoint itself was
a hardcoded constant, so a user whose credit sits with another OpenAI-compatible
images gateway could not use this route at all.

--api-url (or SCHEMATIC_IMAGE_API_URL) now selects the endpoint, defaulting to
the existing OpenRouter URL so current behaviour is unchanged. The endpoint that
was actually called is recorded in request_metadata.json, and request failures
name it. Documents the flag with an OrcaRouter example.
item.label: commit
